title: Rep looks up a call activity for Priya Nair
userProblem: I had a call with Priya Nair about the predictive maintenance pilot. Show me the activity record and when it happened.

expectedOutcome.description: Agent searches activities, finds act_001 (call with Priya Nair about dls_001), and answers with the activity type, date, and notes.

assertions.description: Agent must look the activity up rather than answer from memory.
Search must be scoped to activities.
Answer identifies the correct activity and its type.
A lookup must not mutate data.

rationale: Baseline green scenario for activity lookup. Verifies read path for activities linked to contacts and deals.
